I expect link-time registration will alleviate a lot of the complexity here. Here's an outline of the approach:

https://fekir.info/post/register-functions-at-link-time/#_gnu-ld-without-linker-script
Overall, I don't hate this idea.  I worry a little about maintenance.  Now all apps need the same compiler flags/libraries as eachother.....  that's probably worth it?

This unintentionally is making cpusensor common with the uring elements.  I wonder how much effect that had on the binary size, considering that it likely deleted a bunch of asio executor code (you now compile one executor instead of 2/3).
